tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description:
Get full details and current stock for one Okun Koneosa product.

Args:
    product_id: The numeric product id returned by search_catalog.

Returns:
    JSON with the full product record: id, name, name_raw, sku, ean, brand,
    category, full description (not truncated), price_gross, price_net,

tools.name: create_cart_link

Build a link that puts the given products into the customer's cart.

This tool writes nothing. It returns a URL; the products are added only
when the customer opens that URL in their own browser. Give the URL to the
customer and let them click it.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_shop_policies_and_faqs" stacks urgency/override words (always, override). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Search Okun Koneosa's shop policies and terms. Covers delivery terms, privacy policy, terms of service, the consumer right of withdrawal / returns, company info…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_shop_policies_and_faqs · Private data: get_product_details · Public sink: search_auctions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_shop_policies_and_faqs · Private data: get_product_details · Public sink: search_auctions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
